recipes.name: Eggs Woodhouse For Good from Archer
ingredients: spoonful A generous of beluga caviar (or white sturgeon caviar)
instructions: In a pan, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Cook spinach until bright green and wilted. - A drizzle of olive oil - 1 cup spinach

In a saucepan, melt butter over medium-high heat. Add flour and whisk until combined. Slowly whisk in the milk. Continue whisking until the bechamel sauce thickens. - 3 tbsp butter - 3 tbsp flour - ½ cup milk
Season the spinach with salt and pepper. Then, add the bechamel sauce and give it a good mix. - Salt and pepper
In the bottom of an immersion blender cup, place egg yolks and squeeze lemon on top. Blend together. - 2 egg yolks - Squeeze of lemon juice
Slowly drizzle in melted butter and continue to blend until sauce formed. - 1 stick melted butter
Plate artichoke hearts on a bed of creamed spinach. - 2 warm artichoke hearts

To poach eggs: In a pot, heat water over medium-high heat until almost boiling. In a mesh sieve, swirl eggs before submerging them in the water. Keep the eggs moving and retrieve them after 3 ½ minutes. Place poached eggs on top of the artichokes. - 2 eggs
Liberally stack Ibérico ham on top of the poached eggs. Shave black truffle on top of the ham. Pour warm hollandaise over the entire dish. - Sliced Ibérico ham - Black truffle

Top with a pinch of paprika and kashmiri saffron. Add a spoonful of caviar and enjoy. - sprinkle A of kashmiri saffron - spoonful A generous of beluga caviar (or white sturgeon caviar) - sprinkle A of paprika
